strategy: per-user chronological last-out: train excludes each user's two most recent interactions; validation = second-last, test = last; only users with >= 5 interactions; K=5

weight_tuning.note: Weights selected on validation split only; test outcomes were not consulted. Equal weights are a starting configuration, not an optimum claim.

limitations: Single-split evaluation on one dataset; hit-rate standard error shown but no significance testing across methods; synthetic-data results do not imply real-world effectiveness.
